items.source_en: Thank you for staying with us at Niamos Resort and Hotel! In an effort to improve our experience for your next visit, please rate your current level of satisfaction with our service in the following categories with a value from 1 (Not Satisfied) to 5 (Extremely Satisfied): Overall friendliness and hospitality: 4 Cleanliness: 4 Overall value: 2 Room and Accommodations: 5 Resort Amenities and Activities: 3 Any other comments? This is our second time here, and I must say that while the beaches are nice, I wish they were a little more spread out. We stayed in one of the deluxe beachfront cabanas this visit, which was very posh and comfortable. Though, my husband ordered the "Six Prawn Delight." We felt it was way overpriced, but we're on vacation, and decided to splurge. Unfortunately, he got violently ill afterwards and had to be lifted to the nearest hospital facility off-world. Anyway, I'm kind of enjoying the resort now a little better without him here. It seems much quieter and calmer without his complaining. Also, I was told there would be wind surfing? Why is there no wind surfing?

items.source_en:
Up until the rise of durasteel construction, buildings on Taris rarely reached beyond a few levels. Early structural techniques could not support the weight of towering designs, making even modest skyscrapers a feat of engineering. But as materials and techniques advanced, the ambition to build higher became an obsession.

Nowhere was this more evident than in the creation of Taris Central Tower—a marvel of modern engineering and the defining symbol of the planet’s Upper City. When first completed, it dwarfed every structure before it, standing as a testament to the wealth and power of Taris’ elite. Over time, as techniques improved, expansions and reinforcements allowed the tower to rise even higher, cementing its place as the tallest structure on the planet.

More than just a building, Taris Central Tower became the heart of economic, political, and cultural life. From the corporate boardrooms at its peak to the bustling transit hubs at its base, every level of the tower represented a different facet of Tarisian society.

[Thus begins the architectural chronicle Race to the Heavens, exploring the history, innovations, and legacy of Taris Central Tower—one of the greatest achievements of the planet before its fall.]

듀라스틸 건축이 등장하기 전까지 타리스의 건물들은 거의 몇 층을 넘지 못했습니다. 초기 구조 기술로는 우뚝 솟은 설계의 무게를 지탱할 수 없었기에, 평범한 고층 빌딩조차 공학적 위업이었습니다. 하지만 재료와 기술이 발전함에 따라 더 높이 짓고자 하는 야망은 집착이 되었습니다.

타리스 중앙 타워의 건설보다 이것이 더 잘 드러난 곳은 없었습니다. 현대 공학의 경이로움이자 행성 상층 도시의 상징이었죠. 완공 당시, 이전의 모든 구조물을 압도하며 타리스 엘리트들의 부와 권력을 증명했습니다. 시간이 지나 기술이 향상되면서 확장과 보강을 통해 타워는 더욱 높아졌고, 행성에서 가장 높은 구조물로서의 입지를 굳혔습니다.

단순한 건물을 넘어 타리스 중앙 타워는 경제, 정치, 문화 생활의 중심지가 되었습니다. 꼭대기의 기업 이사회실부터 바닥의 번화한 환승 허브까지, 타워의 모든 층은 타리스 사회의 다른 단면을 대변했습니다.

[이렇게 타리스가 몰락하기 전 가장 위대한 업적 중 하나인 타리스 중앙 타워의 역사, 혁신, 유산을 탐구하는 건축 연대기 '하늘을 향한 경주'가 시작됩니다.]

Up until the wide availability of steel, buildings rarely were over seven stories. The amount of structural support brick buildings needed made going over ten stories effectively impossible. Eighty years after the first skyscrapers were built, techniques advanced so that a building in Dubai was fully double the height of those early goliaths. And the race to go higher, faster was only beginning. Here are the stories and history of some of Earth's most impressive structures.

[Thus begins the architectural novel Race to the Heavens covering the stories of many of the greatest buildings of Earth.]
